article.title: SureSignal以beta整合廣告訊號，供AI買量與既有競價平台接入
article.title_en: SureSignal opens beta for aggregated signals feeding AI buying and existing bidding platforms
article.summary: SureSignal公布訊號聚合平台，以單一API、儀表板及合約連接獨立定向與衡量資料，現處beta階段。
article.summary_en: SureSignal announced a beta signal platform combining independent targeting and measurement inputs behind one API, dashboard and contract.
highlights: 可把組合訊號送入既有競價系統、精選交易與AI代理。
正與小型啟動夥伴群合作；訊號驗證與回饋機制按公司說法歸因。
highlights_en: Signal blends can feed existing bidding systems, curated deals and AI agents.
A small launch-partner group is involved; verification and feedback mechanisms are company descriptions.
article.why: 資料採購與媒體購買可分開管理後，買手可選擇要測試的訊號組合，決定哪些資料值得接入現有投放系統。
article.why_en: Separating signal procurement from media buying lets buyers choose blends to test within their existing delivery systems.
article.next_step: 申請beta時指定一項活動目標，要求列清訊號來源、驗證方法與混合權重，再與原有訊號設定做可比較的測試。
article.next_step_en: For a beta application, specify one objective and request signal sources, verification methods and blend weights before comparing with existing settings.
article.detail: 這是ExchangeWire PressBox刊載的公司公告，並非本刊獨立驗證訊號品質。SSA可理解為把多種廣告訊號集中處理的聚合層，並非另一個媒體購買平台。公司描述用品牌及銷售衡量回饋下一輪權重，尚未提供本篇可驗證的成效結果。編輯建議先釐清每種訊號的覆蓋與評估方法，再決定是否以單一接入取代現有安排。
article.detail_en: This is an issuer announcement carried by ExchangeWire PressBox, not our audit of signal quality. SSA describes a signal-aggregation layer rather than a replacement buying platform. The company describes using brand and sales measurement to adjust future weights, without independently verified results here. Clarify coverage and evaluation methods before changing existing integrations.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
